nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Raw late-envelope energy after image-source wall gating is a reliable localization observable for non-twin cases.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Coda-only errors were 0.1826, 0.4397, and 0.4120 in the three non-twin cases, versus 0.0051 after matched-twin subtraction.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Carrier-phase invariance does not remove the direct-packet tail or repeatable boundary packets; the wall gate alone leaves dominant nuisance contributions.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep matched-twin subtraction and compare early packet residuals after separately estimating the direct shape and wall background.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The steady hold creep rate can be added unchanged to a broad-window unloading slope.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: For spec_A at 8 N, apparent compliance is 0.01597 near onset and 0.05741 later, while steady hold creep is about 0.420 µm/s and the unloading rate is 4.509 N/s. The same additive correction cannot explain both windows.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Once force decreases, a decaying displacement transient and possible elastic curvature both affect the measured slope.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep the measured hold rate as an onset constraint, exclude the transition samples, and compare robust unloading fits with and without force curvature.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The finite saturation fit covers the constant-rate correction in practice.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The constant-rate stress curves returned stiffness errors of 404–442%, while the corresponding finite-saturation curves stayed within 3.15%.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: For a linear force ramp and constant creep, the creep and force terms are collinear. Fitting a saturating term does not recover the missing linear limit unless the independently measured hold rate is applied explicitly.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Test whether coherent unloading curvature is resolvable above sensor noise, and use the exact hold-rate correction when it is not.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Raw pooled feature coordinates support a transferable decision boundary.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: In center 3 the raw pooled model reached 0.650 balanced accuracy, versus 0.845 after within-center alignment and fitting separate training-center intercepts.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Scanner location and scale change across centers whose prevalences also differ, so pooled training can use nuisance measurements to infer center prevalence.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Retain the specified biological terms and isolate scanner alignment, biological ranking, and neutral threshold calibration.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Per-feature test-center centering removes only scanner variation.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: With the same five-term basis, control-panel alignment raised worst-center LOCO balanced accuracy from 0.861 to 0.930.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The locations of the signal features shift with class composition even after scanner correction. Centering those features directly removes part of the biological separation.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Estimate scanner offset and gain from the 43 non-signal features, then fit the contrast, interaction with both main effects, and remaining signal using equal class weights within training centers.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Sibling compaction alone can enforce the 90-leaf cap on the orthogonal tie.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: The 7-variable orthogonal tie still used 128 leaves after testing 448 sibling pairs.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The residual-only perspective relaxation discards separable loss curvature, so freeing a tied indicator creates a real relaxation gap.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Retain a certified diagonal part of the Gram matrix in the box-ridge conjugate, while keeping the residual-only bound as a fallback.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Diagonal loss curvature and sibling compaction suffice to meet the cap for independent blocks of interchangeable columns.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Eight independent duplicate pairs required 545 leaves although the certified objective matched the analytic optimum.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: A coordinate-wise relaxation loses the joint indicator structure within each pair; combinations of equivalent local supports then multiply across blocks.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Certify each small independent block with the minimum of its support-wise box-ridge duals and sum the independent block bounds.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: The local perspective tree with independent-block bounds meets the 90-leaf limit on coupled full-dimension designs.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Normalized dense seed 15 required 101 leaves after compaction, with a gap of 1.78e-15.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The design has no independent row blocks, and the current local bounds leave too many subcubes uncertified before branching.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: When the compacted tree exceeds 90 leaves, evaluate the joint disjunctive box-ridge dual at the root using separate residual duals for every support.
